body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in London, United Kingdom. The listing gives its length as 1.5 hours, over a route of about 4.5 km. It starts at Camden Market, Camden Lock Place, 54-56. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Svetlana as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Join on an unforgettable journey through Camden Town, London's vibrant epicenter of music, alternative culture, and eclectic charm. This self-guided audio tour on your smartphone will take you through the area's rich history, iconic venues, and the stories that have shaped its unique identity.
>
> You'll explore Camden's pivotal role in the rise of punk rock in the 1970s. Iconic bands like The Clash and The Sex Pistols were regulars on the local music scene, cementing Camden's reputation as the epicenter of British punk culture.
>
> No tour of Camden would be complete without paying homage to the late, great Amy Winehouse. The soulful singer was a Camden native and a fixture in the local music scene.
>
> One of the highlights of the tour will be a visit to Camden Market, a sprawling complex of interconnected markets that have been attracting visitors since the 1970s.
>
> Throughout the tour, you'll be immersed in the sights, sounds, and stories that make Camden one of the most exciting and vibrant neighborhoods in London. From the colorful street art and quirky shops to the pulsating energy of the music venues, this tour will leave you with a deeper appreciation for the unique character of this iconic area.
